column1: # Tuned against a real 210-repo scan. The first draft produced ~69 hits of which
# most were noise; each pattern below was tightened against a specific observed
#     so the body may no longer contain hyphens.
#   * openai-key also matched sk-ant-* keys, double-reporting them; now excluded.
#   * aws-access-key matched base64 image data ("AKIAAAAAACKJSBSKUIFI"); low
#     entropy and the AWS docs key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE are filtered in-script.
#   * google-api-key matched random base64 inside .svg/.jpg; binary and image
#   critical = secret grants access, rotate now
#   public   = matches the shape but is public by design (Firebase client keys)

column4: GitHub App installation or Actions token (opaque or stateless format)
OpenAI legacy key (no hyphens in body)
Credentials embedded in a git remote URL
Google API key (may be a public client key or a restricted/unrestricted server key)
